4770-5295-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5147-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2173-2438-5220-7492.description:
Cast Carrion Feeder by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3755-4222-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

2103-7487-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4907-6556-6798-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4907-6556-6798-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

457-5159-5491-7296.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-7296.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2615-7224.easyPrerequisites: An opponent's life total is greater than or equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness, or you control another creature whose toughness is greater than or equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
2615-7224.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness and an opponent's life total.
Cast Soul Immolation by paying {3}{R}{R} and choosing to blight a number of -1/-1 counters equal to an opponent's life total, dealing damage to each opponent and each opposing creature equal to the number of -1/-1 counters placed
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4659-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
4094-4659-5320.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 4.
4094-4659-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

2146-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

967-2097-2511-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

339-677-2034-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-2585-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4593-4659-6291-6719.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Dazzling Angel triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-6291-6719.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

277-1170-3389-5954-6751.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with an indestructible counter on it

5619-6108-6527.easyPrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
5619-6108-6527.description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

440-1339-2034-3641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-3641.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3812-4188-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3812-4188-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Accomplished Alchemist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2080-2556-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-2556-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

317-3197-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-3197-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1379-1902-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1379-1902-1978.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat

2653-3525-5196.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Murasa Rootgrazer.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Island.
2653-3525-5196.description:
Activate a basic Island you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning the Island from your battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting the Island from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Island enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

2585-4067-5074.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tower of Fortunes by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to draw four cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Tower of Fortunes.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Grim Monolith.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

4311-4474-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

264-731.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience attached to Lord of Tresserhorn.
Lord of Tresserhorn does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Lord of Tresserhorn.
264-731.description:
Deal combat damage with Lord of Tresserhorn, causing target opponent to get ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

614-1518-1987-3941.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
614-1518-1987-3941.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
